messages:
alex: Heads-up: GCP told us UK-west1 will have a maintenance window next Tue 02:00-04:00 UTC and quota enforcement may temporarily reduce allocable A100 slots. Planning to run a forecast — can we confirm our committed Dedicated pools and any burst plans? cc @maria @cheng

maria: Got it. Which pools are we talking? Dedicated uk-facing and the eu demo pool that routes to uk for low-latency?

cheng: I can pull current quota/usage. Quick note: some preemptible fallbacks are in place for demo, but not for Dedicated. I'll run `gcloud compute quotas list --project=redwood-uk-prod --filter=ALL` and post numbers.

simon: We also have reserved capacity with VendorX scheduled that week — vendor-side backup should cover Dedicated if GCP evicts. I'll re-check SLA windows.

priya: If Dedicated falls below SLA we should pre-warm model variants to smaller sequences to reduce burst compute. Also flagging ops runbook.

alex: Thanks. @cheng can you paste the quotas and estimated spare slots when you have them? Also, can someone check if our autoscaler will block during maintenance (past bug)?

cheng: ```
$ gcloud compute quotas list --project=redwood-uk-prod --filter=A100
A100 GPUs: limit 40, usage 32 -> spare 8
uk-west1 regional A100: limit 16, usage 14 -> spare 2
```

maria: This matches our monitoring. Dashboard: https://console.redwood/infra/quotas/uk-west1 . Spare capacity looks thin for any big rollout.

gcp-proc-bot: VendorX backup confirmed: 8 A100s available in eu-west1 for 02:00-06:00 UTC window. To trigger failover, update routing policy `region_preference: ['uk-west1','eu-west1']`.

alex: Good. Two asks: 1) can eng-infra agree to a temporary routing policy change if uk-west1 < 4 spare GPUs? 2) @maria can you own messaging to customers with Dedicated SLAs?

maria: I can own customer comms. Will prepare a short status page blurb and pre-approved template.

simon: Engineering ops: I'll hold a 15-min runbook walkthrough Monday 10:30 PT. I'll post calendar invite.

cheng: Follow-ups: I'll open a short PR to autoscaler to ensure it respects maintenance windows (https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/1234). Current numbers: A100 spare total 8, uk-west1 spare 2, eu-west1 spare 6.

alex: Perfect. I'll annotate runbook with vendor failover steps and add a canary check for routing.

priya: One last ask: can we throttle non-prod workloads starting 01:00 UTC Tue to free up preemptible slots? @cheng can you set a scheduled job?

cheng: Yep I'll add a cron job to reduce non-prod scale at 01:00 UTC and revert at 06:30. PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/1235

maria: :thumbsup: will coordinate customer comms and stand by during the window.

alex: :thumbsup: thanks everyone — we'll reconvene Monday after runbook session. tagging #oncall if anything pops.
